offering_description.value: Sells cloud-based supply chain management software and managed services that connect retailers with their suppliers and trading partners. Customers are mainly retailers and their suppliers, delivered through a subscription platform that handles electronic data exchange and order, invoice and compliance workflows.

primary_products.value: supply chain collaboration software; electronic data interchange platform; retail compliance and analytics tools

primary_services.value: managed EDI services; implementation and onboarding; trading partner integration; supply chain consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: retailers, wholesalers, consumer product suppliers, distributors, logistics providers

end_markets.value: retail; consumer goods; wholesale distribution; logistics

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring platform fees for access to the supply chain network; transaction or usage fees: fees based on the volume of documents or transactions exchanged; service fees: implementation, onboarding and managed service fees
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: takes in trading partner data and sells a cloud network to retailers and suppliers; service provider: takes in onboarding and integration needs and provides managed services to trading partners

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with trading partners across North America and beyond

specialization.value: niche specialist: supply chain collaboration and EDI software and services for retail trading partners

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to retailers and suppliers; partners / resellers: technology and service partners that refer or implement the platform

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only normal business rules and data security and privacy obligations apply
